events.name: Ultimate Fan Pass: 30-min Exclusive On-court Access From 5:30pm-6:00pm
events.info: TICKET TO MAIN EVENT ALSO REQUIRED. Get closer to the action with the all-new Ultimate Fan Pass - a limited-capacity, 30-minute pregame on-court experience featuring the Harlem Globetrotters and their Rivals. Be first through the doors and first on the court, where you get exclusive access up close with the players, learn trick shots from the pros, get one-of-a-kind photos, and kick off your own tip-off party before the rest of the crowd arrives. Ultimate Fan Pass guests also get first access to the merchandise stands before the lines form. A separate game ticket is required and is not included with this experience. Minors must be accompanied by an adult who also holds an Ultimate Fan Pass. Soft- or rubber-soled shoes are required on court. The on-court experience begins 90 minutes before game time. Late arrivals may miss some or all of the experience and are not eligible for refunds.

Join the Pre-Game Fan Tunnel to welcome the Harlem Globetrotters to the floor, step into the Pre-Game Huddle, warm up with the team, and watch the famous Globetrotters Magic Circle from just feet away. This is MVP access on another level, and the perfect way to make a memory you'll talk about for years to come. With just 16 passes per game, this is the most exclusive 20 minutes in the arena. Check in at the announcer's table 30 mins prior to the game start. Late arrivals will not be refunded. All participants must have their own MVP Court Pass - no exceptions. Children under 10 must be with an adult who also has an MVP Court Pass. Soft or rubber-soled shoes required. This premium upgrade is not included with your game ticket. Don't miss your chance to be part of the Rivalry as an MVP!

boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call is located at Window #2 and Window #3 at the Hammond Lumber Company Box Office. Any guest picking up tickets at Will Call will be required to show a Valid ID. Tickets will not be released to any party other than the purchaser unless their name was added to the pick-up envelope.

venues.parkingDetail: Attached parking garage to the facility. Also, ground parking located all around the facility. All charge for parking, various rates.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Ticketmaster, on behalf of its clients, strives to make it as easy as possible to purchase accessible seating tickets for venues across the country. Most venues offer accessible seating areas to accommodate their guests. Availability and type of accessible seating tickets will vary based on each venue's policies and/or the type of event taking place. Note: Venues are solely responsible for establishing their own accessible seating ticket policies. Some venues sell all or a portion of their accessible seating tickets only through their box office and not through Ticketmaster. For further information on purchasing accessible tickets, visit our FAQ. Please be advised that wheelchair and companion seating is for guests with disabilities and their companions. Cross Insurance Arena reserves the right to take appropriate action up to and including investigation, relocation, ejection, or season ticket revocation for accessible seating ticket fraud. Accessible seating ticket fraud includes, but is not limited to, misrepresentation of a disability for the purpose of obtaining accessible seating.

generalInfo.childRule: Children welcomed at events. Discounts vary by event. Age for children to enter free varies by event. Usually under 2 is free. Call the box office for information.

events.info: HARLEM GLOBETROTTERS: RIVALRY TOUR Have the Harlem Globetrotters finally met their match? The Washington Generals and new lineup of rivals step onto the court - hungry for a win, and out to prove it! The Harlem Globetrotters - the team that invented basketball culture - bring the Rivalry Tour to your city as part of their 2027 world tour, with a roster of stars who turn every possession into showtime, quarter after quarter. This is a new experience - you're not just watching, you're part of it. You could get pulled onto the court. Join the squad. Own the jumbotron. Because anything can happen at a Globetrotters game. A free, all-new pre-game party kicks off the moment doors open, packed with new surprises for longtime fans and first-time families. This is Globetrotters joy - electric, and built for YOU! The rivalry is theirs. The thrill is yours. Get your tickets now. Groups of 10 can receive a discount by booking through Group Sales at groupsalesCIA@oakviewgroup.com or 207.791.2235.
events.pleaseNote: A warning to any fans with light sensitivity that strobing effects will be used during light shows within the Harlem Globetrotters game. By purchasing this ticket, you give permission to use your likeness. All guests age 2 & older are required to have a ticket. All tickets are subject to availability and prices are subject to change. Groups of 10 can receive a discount by booking through Group Sales at groupsalesCIA@oakviewgroup.com or 207.791.2235.
